[[Sun, the Quivering]] is a [[warrior]] [[boss]] of the [[Am Fah]]. This makes Sun unique as the Am Fah use [[Assassin]]s for front-line combat.

== Locations ==
* [[Kaineng City]]
** {{NPC location|Wajjun Bazaar}} (see [[#Notes|Notes]])

== Skills ==
9-11 [[Strength]]
* {{skill icon|Healing Signet}}
* {{skill icon|Jaizhenju Strike}}
* {{skill icon|Quivering Blade}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Sun and Moon Slash}}
* {{skill icon|Tiger Stance}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Am Fah Vambrace]]
* [[Bolt of Cloth]]
* [[Quivering Blade (weapon)|Quivering Blade]] ([[unique]])
* [[Plague Idol]]

== Notes ==
* If you've completed the [[quest]] [[The Search for a Cure]], you must begin (and complete) the [[Seek out Brother Tosai]] quest and all follow ups. Until you do, all of the Am Fah in the zone will remain friendly and '''he won't spawn until you finish the quest chain'''. If you choose the [[Refuse to Drink]] chain, Sun will spawn sooner, during [[A Monstrous Revelation]].
